development.rules: No checked-in development source; local nodes validate rendered documents with deck and never bind the staging or production issuer, Redis or database endpoints.

boundaryRules.trustedProxySource: KONG_TRUSTED_IPS (exact Caddy source CIDR, no default)

middlewareListenerSplit.disposition: CONSOLIDATE: every new Middleware-governed route targets 8095; 8080 stays only for the reviewed n8n control plane and the prepared provider-control contract until Middleware confirms the listener; 8096 is the control-plane family.

order: more matched criteria (methods, hosts, paths) beat fewer
regex paths beat prefix paths, ordered by regex_priority
longer prefix paths beat shorter prefix paths
equal priority with an overlapping match is AMBIGUOUS and must not be deployed together

STANDARD_API.use: ordinary request/response APIs (control plane, calling, campaign automation)

FAST_SERVICE_API.use: service-to-service APIs with bounded work (callbacks, n8n control plane)

LONG_RUNNING_API.use: reviewed long-running operations and browser UIs

WEBSOCKET.use: long-lived upgrade transports; buffering off; no reviewed Kong route today (calling contract forbids a public Kong WebSocket route)

SSE.use: server-sent event streams; response buffering off, no retry; no reviewed route today

LEGACY_CONNECT_5S.use: observed legacy services; not for canonical use

LEGACY_FAST_5S.use: observed legacy services; not for canonical use

KONG_DEFAULT_60S.use: Kong defaults observed on legacy services; forbidden for canonical services

KONG_DEFAULT_IMPLICIT.use: no timeout declared; Kong defaults apply; design-only

NONE.use: commands, mutations, identity, standby: surface the failure

TRANSPORT_CONNECT_ONLY_1.use: one re-attempt; nginx does not re-send a non-idempotent request whose bytes reached the upstream (proxy_next_upstream without non_idempotent), so only connect-phase failures are retried

KONG_DEFAULT_IMPLICIT.use: no retries declared; Kong default 5; design-only

UNRECORDED_READBACK.use: the production readback does not capture retries; assume Kong default until captured

HEALTH_EDGE.note: public probes are edge-owned; Kong health routes share their service limiter

ROUTE_SPECIFIC.note: service-level marker; each route selects its own profile

UNRECORDED_READBACK.note: rate-limiting present, value not captured by the sanitized readback

UNSPECIFIED_CONTRACT.note: prepared contract does not declare a rate

NONE.note: no rate limiting; only tolerated on legacy, blocked or design routes

NONE_READ_ONLY.note: read-only routes carry no body limit

UNBOUNDED.note: mutation route without a body limit; only tolerated on legacy, blocked or design routes

health.DNS_TARGET_PASSIVE: single DNS target, no Kong upstream object: connection refusal, DNS failure and timeout surface as the route's 502/503/504 and never fall back
health.ACTIVE_HTTP_REQUIRED: multi-target or TLS upstream: Kong upstream object with active HTTP health checks on healthPath is required before activation
health.NONE_FIXTURE: test or standby fixture without a health contract
health.EDGE_OWNED: health is answered by Caddy or the websocket gateway, not by a Kong route

observability.PROMETHEUS_GLOBAL_CORRELATION: global prometheus metrics on the private status listener plus correlation-id on the route
observability.PROMETHEUS_GLOBAL_ONLY: global prometheus metrics; correlation handled by a session plugin or absent
observability.UNRECORDED_READBACK: observed route; logging/metrics plugin configuration not captured

authenticationClasses.PUBLIC: no gateway credential; read-only or legacy browser form with an explicit publicReason
authenticationClasses.AUTHENTICATED: end-user or client credential validated by the gateway (OIDC bearer, session, or legacy shared key)
authenticationClasses.SERVICE_AUTHENTICATED: service credential (client_credentials JWT/OIDC) with audience and scope prerequisites
authenticationClasses.ADMIN_INTERNAL: platform administration; explicit admin scope; never reachable without a credential
authenticationClasses.INTERNAL: private network plus service credential (private VLAN, standby, IP-restricted)

findingCodes.LEGACY_HOST: route binds the legacy public host
findingCodes.PLACEHOLDER_HOST: route binds an RFC 2606 .invalid placeholder host
findingCodes.METHODS_UNSPECIFIED: route declares no methods (all methods match)
findingCodes.ALL_METHODS: route declares six or more methods
findingCodes.CATCH_ALL_PATH: route path is / or a wildcard
findingCodes.CATCH_ALL_PREFIX: route path is an API root prefix
findingCodes.ADMIN_PATH: route path contains an administrative segment
findingCodes.PLUGIN_SET_UNSPECIFIED: source does not enumerate the route plugin set
findingCodes.NO_GATEWAY_AUTHENTICATION: no authentication plugin on the effective route
findingCodes.CORS_WITH_SHARED_KEY: cors and key-auth together: the key is exposed to browsers
findingCodes.AUDIENCE_IS_CLIENT_ID: the route audience equals the client id; acceptable only when contractually defined
findingCodes.UPSTREAM_HOST_UNRESOLVED: upstream host is a deployment variable
findingCodes.DIRECT_PROVIDER_UPSTREAM: upstream is an external provider or scraper
findingCodes.DIRECT_APPLICATION_UPSTREAM: upstream is an application, not Middleware; requires directUpstreamReason on the service
findingCodes.KONG_DEFAULT_TIMEOUTS: service timeouts equal the Kong 60s defaults
findingCodes.RETRIES_UNDECLARED: contract does not declare retries; the renderer or reconciler must pin the profile before activation
findingCodes.TIMEOUTS_UNDECLARED: contract does not declare timeouts; the renderer or reconciler must pin the profile before activation

plugins.purpose: Raw request-metadata guards only (correlation header presence); never claims or scopes.
plugins.orderingDependency: Runs before every authentication plugin; must not read credentials or claims.

plugins.purpose: Strip caller identity headers, validate/mint correlation, request id and traceparent, add response security headers.
plugins.orderingDependency: Runs before correlation-id and before authentication so spoofed identity never reaches a plugin.

plugins.purpose: Generate X-Correlation-ID (uuid) and echo it downstream.
plugins.orderingDependency: Runs before authentication and logging so every decision carries the id.

plugins.purpose: Source allowlist for the private standby routes and private integration policies.
plugins.orderingDependency: Runs before token authentication; a denied source never reaches a credential check.

plugins.purpose: User-agent based abuse control on legacy public website forms.
Browser preflight for legacy website routes; credentials with a wildcard origin are forbidden.
plugins.orderingDependency: Runs before key-auth so OPTIONS preflights are answered without credentials.

plugins.purpose: RS256 signature and exp verification keyed by azp against the realm JWKS credential.
plugins.orderingDependency: Must complete before post-function claim guards (priority -1000).

plugins.purpose: Legacy shared API keys; not permitted for new production routes (config/integrations/policies/legacy-api-key.json).
plugins.orderingDependency: Runs after cors; the only credential check on legacy routes.

plugins.purpose: Bearer validation against the Keycloak realm: signature via discovery/JWKS, issuer, expiry, audience, scopes_required, consumer mapping by azp.
plugins.orderingDependency: Must complete before post-function and codestra-authz; never global because the audience differs per service.

plugins.purpose: Client-certificate authentication for the private mTLS integration policy.
Versioned HMAC verification of signed webhook bytes with per-integration vault keys; replay denial stays in Middleware.
plugins.orderingDependency: Sole authentication on signed-webhook routes; runs before request-size-limiting so it bounds its own body read.

plugins.purpose: Bound request bodies per request-size profile; require Content-Length on command routes.
plugins.orderingDependency: Runs after authentication so an anonymous oversized body is rejected as 401 first.

plugins.purpose: Per-profile request rate; redis policy with fault_tolerant false on canonical routes, local policy only on the private standby node.
plugins.orderingDependency: Runs after authentication and request-size-limiting; counters are keyed by consumer where a credential exists.

plugins.purpose: Route authorization prerequisites after openid-connect: issuer, audience, authorized party, time claims, scopes, realm roles, tenant.
plugins.orderingDependency: Requires openid-connect (1050) to have accepted the request; never verifies signatures itself.

plugins.purpose: Strip trusted identity headers before the upstream (standby, legacy communication routes, egress proposal).
plugins.orderingDependency: Runs after authentication; must never add identity headers a guard did not mint.

plugins.purpose: Response header shaping on the MoneyBee bootstrap route.
plugins.orderingDependency: Header-filter phase only; must not remove correlation or security headers.

plugins.purpose: Node, request, latency, bandwidth and upstream-health metrics on the private status listener; per-consumer and AI metrics disabled.
plugins.orderingDependency: Log phase; independent of other plugins.

plugins.purpose: Explicit deny for quarantined or disabled route variants (legacy host termination on intake, callback quarantine).
plugins.orderingDependency: Runs last in access; only reached when every earlier plugin admitted the request.

plugins.purpose: Claim guards that consume verified authentication state: scope, tenant, campaign, authorized party, minted identity headers.
plugins.orderingDependency: Priority -1000: the only serverless phase that observes the result of jwt/openid-connect; never attach a claim guard as pre-function.
